# Capacitor Auth Manager — Documentation Index

> capacitor-auth-manager is a TypeScript-first, framework-agnostic authentication library that puts 15 sign-in providers behind one API for React, Vue, Angular, vanilla JS, and optional Capacitor (iOS/Android) apps. Author: Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com). npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/capacitor-auth-manager. MIT-licensed.

## About

The library exposes an `auth` singleton (works like a store — no context provider needed). You call `auth.configure({ providers })` once, then `auth.signIn('<provider-id>')` from any framework. The 15 providers are: Google, Apple, Microsoft, Facebook, GitHub, Slack, LinkedIn, Firebase, email-password, username-password, phone-password, email-code (OTP), SMS (OTP), magic-link, and biometric. Security defaults include S256 PKCE on manual OAuth code flows, OIDC nonce + ID-token exp validation (signatures are NOT verified client-side — re-validate server-side), pluggable secure storage, and an AES-GCM web fallback for biometric material. The web layer implements all 15 providers (primary surface); the native Capacitor plugin is a secondary surface (iOS: 7 native providers; Android: 3).

This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/intro): what it is, what it does and does not do.
- [Installation](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/installation): npm install + optional peers + entry points.
- [Quick Start](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/quick-start): configure → signIn → onAuthStateChange in 5 minutes.
- [Configuration](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/configuration): the full AuthManagerConfig shape.

## Framework Adapters

- [Vanilla JS](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/frameworks/vanilla-js): the `auth` singleton API.
- [React](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/frameworks/react): useAuth, useAuthState, useAuthProvider, useUser, useIsAuthenticated.
- [Vue](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/frameworks/vue): useAuth, useAuthState, useUser, useAuthProvider, useAuthConfig.
- [Angular](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/frameworks/angular): AuthService, AuthModule, AuthGuard, NoAuthGuard.
